data.title: Verified automatic WhatsApp delivery through the room conversation product flow. Paired bridge is running and checks pass; room calendar remains explicitly simulated.

evidence: The product flow worked: the API found the simulated booking conflict, composed a fresh message, queued it, and the paired bridge sent it automatically. WhatsApp confirmed delivery about three seconds after queueing.

data.spec: POST /api/input accepts optional event_id/conversation_id for room followups on one durable task; dashboard transcript and speech DeviceEvent inputs also work. GET /api/room-conversations/{conversation_id} returns authoritative progress, also exposed through request trace and task.updated/requests.updated/board.say plus room.progress events. Outgoing delivery uses the paired apps/whatsapp worker. Unclaimed jobs expire after two minutes; interrupted claims become visibly uncertain after 30 seconds and never automatically retry. Successful sent/delivered/read receipts require a WhatsApp message reference; late receipts can reconcile uncertain delivery. ROOM_CALENDAR_PATH defaults to ignored .data/room-calendar.json, with structure in config/room-calendar.example.json; current calendar data is explicitly simulated.

evidence: Uncertain sends never retry. Unclaimed jobs expire after two minutes; interrupted claims become visibly uncertain after 30 seconds.
